caption: Simulator versus theory. (a, b) Mean over 200 runs with 95% confidence intervals for two real genomes; solid lines: exact formulas derived for this simulator; dashed: Lander-Waterman. On short genomes the genome ends leave more positions uncovered than exp(-c) predicts, and the exact model explains this. (c) On a long genome, where the approximation applies, exp(-c) holds (100 runs per point).
